stem.text: Which reaction has a product that gives a yellow precipitate when treated with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$?

A.text: 2-chloropropane is warmed with a dilute aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide.

B.text: Ethanal is heated under reflux with acidified potassium dichromate(VI).

C.text: Methyl ethanoate is heated under reflux with dilute sulfuric acid.

D.text: Propanal is reacted with $\text{NaBH}_4$, followed by dilute sulfuric acid.
